# 2009 Nigeria Entertainment Awards

The 2009 Nigeria Entertainment Awards was held at Howard University Cramton Auditorium on June 9, 2009. It was hosted by Omoni Oboli and Ebbe Bassey
Awards
; Best Album of the Year
* Entertainer (D'Banj)
* My P (Naeto C)
* Unstoppable (Tuface)
* Undareyted (Dare)
* Talk About It (MI)
; Hottest Single of the Year
* "Big Boy" (Eldee)
* "Good or Bad" (J Martins)
* "Shayo" (Durella)
* "Bumper to Bumper" (Wande Coal)
* "Efi Mile" (YQ Ft Dagrin)
; Best New Act of the Year
* MI
* Durella
* YQ
* J Martins
* Bigiano

* Midnight Crew
* Nikki Laoye
* Roof Top Mcs
* Lara George
* Yinka Aiyefele
